demos.question: How many distinct orders were placed during 'Winter Classics 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar? Return an integer.
demos.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID=o.CustomerID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-12-01' AND '2017-12-31'

demos.question: How many orders placed in 2018 have no shipped date recorded? Return an integer.
demos.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders o WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND ShippedDate IS NULL;
